title: Working together with an rn-craft React Native app

R1.reason: A single baseQuery sets Authorization (Firebase ID token) and X-App-Locale from i18n.language, read on every request.

R2.reason: ApiError extended with code, requestId, status and retryAfter from the Retry-After header, and adds conflict and rateLimited kinds. It states that rn-craft's current type lacks these.

R3.reason: applyApiErrors maps details[].field to setError, with a root.server fallback and focus handling.

R4.reason: Uses build.infiniteQuery with getNextPageParam from meta.nextCursor, flattens data pages, handles INVALID_CURSOR, and ties filters to the cache key.

R5.reason: Backend users.id is used for Adapty identify and analytics. The Firebase uid is an auth detail only. Premium comes from the server /me and webhooks, and the client is never trusted.

R6.reason: Unlinks the device before resetSession, handles 401 failure, and the backend re-binds the token on PUT with delete-by-fcm_token, so account switches are handled.

R7.reason: One Idempotency-Key per user action is kept in a ref and reused on retries. New keys are minted only after a definite outcome. Writes retry only when they carry a key. Backend replay and fingerprint handling are included.

R8.reason: Says the source was not available, that paths are proposals, that rn-craft's current ApiError lacks these cases, and that nothing was run or edited.

forbidden.item: Making rn-craft a dependency of the backend or the backend a dependency of the app
forbidden.evidence: The app and backend are kept separate and are connected only through the HTTP contract.

forbidden.item: Trusting isPremium or userId from the client
forbidden.evidence: "A userId or isPremium in a body or header is never trusted"; premium is derived on the server.

forbidden.item: Generating a new idempotency key on each retry
forbidden.evidence: The key is kept in a useRef and reused across retries. A new key is created only after a definite outcome or a cart change.

forbidden.item: Claiming rn-craft already supports these headers or error cases
forbidden.evidence: "rn-craft's current type has none of these"; the new files are described as proposals.

grade.summary: The answer covers every rubric item with correct, concrete code. It is honest about gaps in the current rn-craft version and violates no forbidden decision.
